svg.text: Greater petrosal nerve: lacrimal gland and glands of the nose and palate.
Nerve to stapedius: damps loud sound. Chorda tympani: taste from the
anterior two-thirds of the tongue; submandibular and sublingual glands.
岩大神经：泪腺及鼻、腭腺体。镫骨肌神经：缓冲强声。鼓索：舌前三分之二的味觉；下颌
